result.topic_en: Hilbert sketches building a fundamental domain (Urbereich) for a substitution group by expanding convex bodies until they touch and fill space, proposes using it for automorphic functions linked to higher continued-fraction algorithms, and begins the case n=2 with lattice conditions for a reduced region.
